Kay Jewelers, Signet's largest banner, is cutting store inventory 20% to relaunch under a new "Love All In" platform.

The shift keeps bridal and milestone bestsellers while adding self-expression, gifting and men's jewelry, Kay president Julie Yoakum told JCK. A New York Fashion Week collaboration piece carries 550 diamonds, with stores and packaging following in 2027.
